title: Channel frontal passage, mid-March 2023
notes: Mid-March 2023 was persistently unsettled over NW Europe (Storm Larisa hit on 10 Mar; further Atlantic fronts followed); 13 Mar saw a frontal system cross the Channel within a broad cyclonic regime. No position expectation — this is a 'detector finds the synoptic driver of a corroborated frontal day' case. Confidence: moderate (recollection of the unsettled spell, not of a specific named centre).
